newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Nov primary deficit at 858 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Nov primary deficit at 858 mln reais.

text.p: Brazil posted a primary deficit in the federal sector of 858 million reais in November, with total receipts of 7.465 billion reais and expenses of 8.322 billion reais, the National Treasury said.
The figure compares with a 32 million real surplus in October and a surplus of 843 million reais in November 1995.

October figures reduced the federal primary surplus to 4.017 billion reais or 0.57 percent of gross domestic product in the first 11 months of the year, down from 6.404 billion reais or 0.93 percent of GDP in the same period last year.

Brazil's operational deficit, which includes debt costs, totalled 7.799 billion reais, 1.11 percent of GDP in the January-to-November period, compared with 6.938 billion reais or 1.01 percent of GDP in the first 11 months of 1995.

Under the Treasury's cash concept, the November deficit reached 1.44 billion reais, bringing the year-to-date deficit to 7.849 billion reais, compared with 2.185 billion reais in the same period last year.

The figures were different from primary and operational data released by the Finance Ministry on Tuesday. Unlike Tuesday's data, Wednesday's figures did not take into account the performance of state companies, the social security system and other factors.
